14 Aug 2023
First notice of loss received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
11 Sep 2023
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They confirm several details of the scene and the position of the
vehicles, though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
9 Oct 2023
Vehicle damage on the claimant's side is consistent with the impact described in the report. The estimate lines up
with the damage pattern shown in the photos, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records.
6 Nov 2023
Police report conifrms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver is named on the policy,
and nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage period began.
23 Nov 2023
Claimant repotrs a knee injury from the crash. The injury fits the type and force of the collision, and no prior injury to
the same area is known from the claimant's history.
28 Nov 2023
Claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including through counsel. Medical
records show treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
16 Jan 2024
Recommend the file proceed to settlement review based on the documented damage, consistent medical treatment,
and the policy being in force at the time of loss. Counsel to be advised of the reserve and next steps.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
